title: Send an SMS
summary: Send an SMS with one REST call, and handle a request that fails.

folds: duplicate status callbacks are your handler's problem - idempotency is app-side, stated as such
evidence: demo barbiera reminders.py:56-72 RestClient(...).messages.create from a cron script

resolved: RestClient has no native messages namespace (sdk-surface §8; docs server-sdks/reference/python/rest/client) - use client.compat.messages.create, direct native REST, or RelayClient.send_message; do not imply platform idempotency
